definition.label: Move, turn or resize a construction
definition.description: Transform 1–16 idle creations as one arrangement with one save/Undo. The first member's CURRENT live pose is the pivot. position is its desired room-local origin; rotation is its desired absolute unit quaternion; scale multiplies every member's current scale and its distance from the pivot. A factor of 1 preserves size. Supply current revisions and include both ends of all connections. Pause physics, drawings, playback and authoring and release members first. Every final piece must remain within 25 metres and scale 0.1–4; otherwise nothing changes. Does not alter geometry, recorded animations, hinge frames or saved structure baselines. It does not connect pieces, prevent overlaps or snap to the scan. The physical construction handle uses this same projection and action on release. Failed admission/save leaves the complete original arrangement; replay cannot move it twice. Stop cannot undo a completed transform. Temporary edits stay in their room fork.
